The vendor directly providing the software platform at **yotpo.com** is **Yotpo Ltd.** (operating with affiliates including **Yotpo Inc.**).

### Supporting Evidence:
* **Terms of Service (`yotpo.com/terms-of-service/`)**: Defines the provider and product as: 
  > *“‘YOTPO’ MEANS YOTPO LTD. AND ITS AFFILIATES... Yotpo's platform is a unique, proprietary consumer engagement platform (‘Platform’) that offers solutions for customer reviews, visual marketing, SMS/MMS engagement programs, and loyalty and referral programs...”*
* **Terms of Use (`yotpo.com/terms-of-use/`)**:
  > *“Welcome to https://www.yotpo.com/ (together with any related websites, the ‘Site’). The Site is owned and operated by Yotpo Ltd. and its affiliates (‘Yotpo’).”*
* **Privacy Policy (`yotpo.com/privacy-policy/`)**:
  > *“This Privacy Policy describes how Yotpo Ltd. (together with its affiliated companies – ‘Yotpo’, ‘we’, ‘our’ or ‘us’) collects, stores, uses, and discloses your personal data when you interact with us, including when you: register for and/or use the Yotpo services, including the Yotpo eCommerce marketing platform, products and applications (collectively, ‘Platform’)...”*
